items.title: 73243_Joe Thomas oral history interview
items.q: The interviewee addresses the interviewer as 'Stanley' ('Well, Stanley, I was born...'), indicating the person named 'Crock Stanley Stanley' is likely the interviewer, W. Stanley Dance. The transcript shows no personal interaction or relationship between the interviewee (Joe Thomas) and a third part

ctx.x: Well, where were you born, Joe?
Well, Stanley, I was born in Webster Groves, Missouri.
